template._note: H3 renders 17k+5 frames, at most 3592; width and height must be multiples of 32. A shot after the first in a continuous sequence spends 22 frames on the chain.

recipe._note: Pictures 1-3 are the shot's subjects (characters first, then props and vehicles, in script order); Picture 4 is always the location plate. Each character is fed ONE panel of its 4-panel sheet: the face panel on a single-character close-up, the three-quarter body panel otherwise. Clone mode feeds one voice sample per speaker, at most 3.

retention._note: H3's audio retention markers, and the IR's neutral `preserve` mapped onto them. fully_copy makes a dub slice the whole soundtrack; partially_copy copies the voices and lets H3 add foley; reference only borrows timbre and timing.

size_hints.voice sample: 5-15 seconds of clean speech, mono wav

models._note: The family each model param must be (targets/modelid.py). Names are checked first (case-insensitive globs; a series config's model_families adds more), then the file's header. Ref2VA and FL2VA share every tensor, so a file named neither is accepted as H3 with a note, and one named FL2VA is refused. Tiers (docs/API.md): the turbo LoRA is an accelerator (without it the pass renders its `base`); the rest are required. text_encoder / video_vae / audio_vae are the workflow's own files (`default`): patched only when another file of the family stands in. A substitute LoRA keeps the wanted one's step count (`keep`).

presets._note: Turbo LoRA per pass. The final pass uses lightx2v's 8-step Ref2V v1.0, distilled at 768p for exactly 8 steps. The proxy keeps the 4-step v0.1: a distilled LoRA is trained on a fixed set of timesteps, so it does best at its own step count, and the proxy wants 4 steps for speed. The series config's `series` and `proxy` blocks override these. `base` is what a pass renders with when its turbo LoRA isn't installed: no LoRA, 20 steps with res_multistep (ComfyUI's H3 templates, video_minimax_h3_r2v.json / _i2v / _t2v, full branch: 'Int (Full)' 20, KSamplerSelect res_multistep, BasicScheduler simple) and no CFG, as those templates guide with BasicGuider and so does this workflow ('Guider (CFG 1)').

downloads._note: Where to get each file this target names (docs/API.md 'Downloads'). A url is only given when a trustworthy record has it: a ComfyUI template's or saved workflow's properties.models entry, or ComfyUI-Manager's model list; `source` says which. Otherwise url is null and source says what to search for. Never a guessed URL.
